model.name: parallax scroll
model.description: As the user scrolls down the page, different layers move at distinct speeds relative to the viewport. The textual content ('Lipton's Story') scrolls upward at normal speed while the background/portrait image of Sir Thomas Lipton moves at a slower rate, creating depth before continuing to the subsequent content sections.
model.how_to_implement: Can be implemented natively with modern CSS scroll-driven animations (`animation-timeline: scroll()` / `view()`) or using GSAP ScrollTrigger to translate the portrait element (`transform: translateY(...)`) at a slower velocity than the document scroll.
